Integrations.title: Integrations
Integrations.platformHelp: Manage platform providers and inspect tenant connection health. Tenant credentials remain private.
Integrations.tenantHelp: Configure approved connections for this workspace. Your subscription controls availability.
Integrations.developerHelp: Connect external systems to this workspace using least-privilege API keys and signed webhooks.
Integrations.platformWebhookHelp: Inspect tenant-owned webhook metadata. Configuration remains with the owning workspace.
Integrations.configurationHelp: Only non-secret configuration belongs here. Save credentials separately, then test and activate.
Integrations.environmentHelp: Development credentials are read-only environment values. Set SETU_SECRET_ followed by the connection UUID without hyphens, in uppercase, on the API process. Use AWS Secrets Manager for credential writes and webhook creation.
Integrations.neverRetrieve: Saved credentials cannot be retrieved. Replacing a credential requires a new connection test.
Integrations.oneTimeHelp: Copy this value now. It will not be shown again after you dismiss or leave this page.
Integrations.apiDisabled: Public API access is not enabled for this workspace subscription.
Integrations.documentationHelp: Use a scoped API key in the Authorization header. All returned records belong to the key's workspace. Results are paginated with page and page_size.
Integrations.rateLimitHelp: Limits: 60 requests per key per minute and 300 per workspace per minute. Respect Retry-After on HTTP 429.
Integrations.webhookHelp: Webhooks use HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp, a dot, and the exact request body. Verify X-Setu-Signature and X-Setu-Timestamp within five minutes.
Integrations.webhookDedup: Deduplicate using the event ID. Delivery is at least once. Redirects and private-network destinations are rejected.
Integrations.oauthDeferred: OAuth client registration requires an approved identity provider. No custom OAuth callbacks are enabled.
Integrations.emptyConnections: No managed connections match these filters.
Integrations.actionFailed: The action failed. Check configuration and try again.
Integrations.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the displayed value manually.
Integrations.deleteConfirm: Delete this webhook and disable future deliveries?

errors.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Authentication failed. Replace credentials or reconnect the account.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Rate limit reached. Try again later.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The provider is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.TIMEOUT: The provider did not respond in time.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have access to this capability.
errors.SECRET_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The secret store is unavailable or read-only.

Integrations.allowFallback: Explicitly allow platform fallback for this provider and environment
Integrations.healthRecorded: Recorded health from explicit connection tests. Pages do not call external providers automatically.
Integrations.providerAlertMessage: A configured integration failed three consecutive connection checks. Review the integration health page.
